notes: «أن عمر بن عبيد الله بن معمر، رمدت عينه» is the story whose subject is Umar; he has no transmission verb tying him to the report, so he is not a link (rule 2 and rule 5). The matn starts at «عمر». «وحدث عن عثمان بن عفان عن النبي» comes after the saying: Umar narrates from Uthman, a second isnad written after the matn, so it is not a route (rule 9). «أبان بن عثمان» is named inside the story and is not a link. «حدثني أبي» is Abd al-Samad's father, a relation.
